##: China edition from trae.cn; the international build at trae.ai is a separate package that shares the same app data folder and the trae:// protocol, so both cannot run side by side.
The vendor API only publishes the build id used in the URL path (2.3.2839); the app itself reports 3.5.20. The build id is the manifest version, matching the upstream trae manifest.
The 218 MB Inno Setup installer is unpacked with innounp; the payload lives in the {code_GetDestDir} folder, so extract_dir selects it and the {app}\tools installer helpers are dropped.
The vendor publishes no checksums, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and Excavator downloads the installer to refresh the hash.
description: AI-powered IDE from ByteDance, China edition
notes: User data is written to "$env:APPDATA\Trae" and "$env:USERPROFILE\.trae"; neither is persisted by Scoop.
The CLI wrapper is exposed as 'trae-cn' so it does not collide with an international Trae installation.
